environment.network: local loopback; no external network latency

workload.pattern: Each virtual user alternates GET /api/services and GET /api/bookings?page=1&limit=20. One outstanding request per user.
workload.warmup: Two unmeasured requests per user after login; authentication and setup excluded from measured latency.

target: At least 95% of measured requests per endpoint return valid expected data in strictly less than 2000 ms.
limits: Local prototype evaluation only. Does not measure cloud hosting, browser rendering, real network conditions, or unlimited production capacity.
cleanup: Isolated API stopped. Test database retained for reproducibility. No existing application records were modified.
